summary: Roadside parking beside a riverside park, with homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto park, other cars park here

drivers.traffic: Quiet no-through end of a residential street; a footpath runs past the pin.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the park side in both images; no signs seen.
